mapper.select: SELECT 'activeTenants' AS `key`, '有效租户' AS label, CAST(COUNT(*) AS CHAR) AS value, 'live' AS trend FROM plat_tenant WHERE deleted = 0 AND status = 'ACTIVE' AND id = #{tenantId} UNION ALL SELECT 'datasources', '已登记数据源', CAST(COUNT(*) AS CHAR), 'live' FROM int_datasource WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND deleted = 0 UNION ALL SELECT 'jobsToday', '今日启动任务', CAST(COUNT(*) AS CHAR), 'live' FROM sched_job_log WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND started_at >= CURRENT_DATE AND started_at < CURRENT_DATE + INTERVAL 1 DAY UNION ALL SELECT 'generatedModules', '已发布动态模型', CAST(COUNT(*) AS CHAR), 'live' FROM gen_dynamic_model WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND deleted = 0 AND status = 'PUBLISHED'
